name: w_saxpy8_hand
description: W-full の手書きの命令列（#110 のオーナーの進め方の1）: saxpy8 の out(i) = a * x(i) + y(i) を、a のブロードキャストの VMAC（rd = rs3 の累算）4つと LD.W・ST.W で書く。入力は crosscheck/HandComputedSpec と同じ a = 3、x = 1..8、y = 10..80 で、out(i) = 13(i+1)。x は語 0..7、y は 8..15、a は 16、out は 17..24（ST.W はすべて奇数の番地）。VMAC と ST.W は同じ bundle に置けない（欄4、L11）。cycles は手で数えた
program: @0:  nop                                 | ld r1, [16]        ; a, visible from 2
@1:  nop                                 | ld.w r2:r3, [0]    ; x0 x1, from 3
@2:  nop                                 | ld.w r4:r5, [8]    ; y0 y1, from 4
@3:  nop                                 | ld.w r6:r7, [2]    ; x2 x3, from 5
@4:  vmac r4:r5, r1, r2:r3, r4:r5        | ld.w r8:r9, [10]   ; out0 out1 from 6; y2 y3 from 6
@5:  nop                                 | ld.w r10:r11, [4]  ; x4 x5, from 7
@6:  vmac r8:r9, r1, r6:r7, r8:r9        | ld.w r12:r13, [12] ; out2 out3 from 8; y4 y5 from 8
@7:  nop                                 | st.w [17], r4:r5   ; [17] (bank 1) and [18] (bank 0, next row)
@8:  vmac r12:r13, r1, r10:r11, r12:r13  | ld.w r2:r3, [6]    ; out4 out5 from 10; x6 x7 from 10
@9:  nop                                 | ld.w r6:r7, [14]   ; y6 y7, from 11
@11: vmac r6:r7, r1, r2:r3, r6:r7        ; out6 out7 from 13; no ST.W beside a VMAC (L11)
@13: nop                                 | st.w [23], r6:r7   ; done at E_14
